briefings.title: Sovereignty: Out-of-Distribution
briefings.tldr: Palantir CEO Alex Karp and Palantir Sovereign lead Louis Robson discuss technological sovereignty, explaining how enterprises derive true value by protecting and ontologizing their unique "out-of-distribution" data and human artistry rather than relying on generic, commoditized models.

briefings.title: Building the Sovereign Enterprise with David A. Steinberg and Dr. Alex Karp | Zeta Live '26
briefings.tldr: AI is transitioning enterprises into a high-stakes, post-generative era where companies must integrate operational intelligence with absolute data sovereignty to protect their unique business alpha.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and Palantir CEO Alex Karp participate in a fireside chat — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: Alex Karp (Palantir CEO) and Howard Lutnick (Commerce Secretary) discussed AI sovereignty and ecosystem strategy at the G20 Innovation Ministerial, emphasizing that nations must secure their own data and technical stacks rather than inadvertently exporting proprietary intelligence to American frontier labs.

briefings.title: Palantir & Ondas | Building the Future of Mission Autonomy | Episode 2
briefings.tldr: Through the newly formed Ondas Sentinel, Ondas and Palantir are unifying autonomous defense technologies—ranging from ground robotics and counter-UAS to stratospheric balloons—powered by the Skyweaver Agentic AI orchestration platform to compress military decision timelines from hours to single-digit minutes.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC’s full interview with Palantir CEO Alex Karp
briefings.tldr: Palantir CEO Alex Karp defends the company's "sovereign AI" and open-weight model strategy, arguing that enterprises must retain control of their proprietary data and alpha rather than engaging in a "parasitic" relationship with frontier labs.

briefings.title: All-Hands at Palantir | Dr. Karp on Sovereign AI
briefings.tldr: Dr. Karp outlined Palantir's strategic push into the Sovereign AI revolution, framing it as a global movement to help enterprises and governments protect their intellectual property and maintain control of their production means.

briefings.title: Palantir's Ted Mabrey on AI, Healthcare, and the Future of Innovation | ARK Big Ideas Summit
briefings.tldr: Through a highly successful six-year partnership, Tampa General Hospital (TGH) and Palantir have demonstrated the life-saving potential of operationalizing AI in healthcare, establishing the Tampa Bay region as the premier innovation hub of the southern "Boom Belt."

briefings.title: AIPCon 10 June 2026 | Livestream
briefings.tldr: True business value in the AI era is unlocked not by generic large language models, but by combining LLMs with Palantir’s Ontology and Apollo deployment infrastructure.

briefings.title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Tokenmaxxing & Taste
briefings.tldr: Enterprise AI is currently trapped in an addictive, superficial cycle of "tokenmaxxing" that fails to deliver true return on investment (ROI).

briefings.title: Palantir, Ondas & World View | Multi-Domain Intelligence in the Stratosphere
briefings.tldr: By integrating World View’s stratospheric balloon technology into Ondas’s multi-domain autonomous portfolio, and leveraging Palantir's Foundry, Warp Speed, and Agentic AI, this partnership is streamlining defense-tech supply chains and enabling autonomous, machine-to-machine mission orchestration to deliver rapid "speed to decision" for warfighters.

briefings.title: The State of Modern War: Palantir & Anduril Execs on Drones, AI, and the End of Traditional Warfare
briefings.tldr: The United States has lost its "Arsenal of Democracy" edge, facing a massive production gap with China that threatens global deterrence.

briefings.title: KI im Krieg: Ex-Palantir-Genie über Drohnen statt Kampfpiloten und den Masterplan von Helsing
briefings.tldr: Robert Fink, the architect behind Palantir’s flagship "Foundry" platform, is now scaling Helsing as Europe’s first software-first "Defense Prime" to ensure geopolitical sovereignty through AI-driven electronic warfare, autonomous drones, and unmanned combat aircraft.

briefings.title: How American Industry Wins the AI Era | AIPCon 9 Discussion
briefings.tldr: To dominate the AI era, the United States must reintegrate its industrial base with its national security goals, shifting from a peacetime "compliance" mindset to an "outcome-led" war footing that prioritizes decision dominance, domestic energy independence, and high-agency talent.

briefings.title: 🔴 Dr. Alex Karp LIVE on TBPN
briefings.tldr: Palantir is positioning itself as the "Iron Man suit" for institutional experts, driving a shift from traditional software to AI-integrated operations that CEO Dr. Alex Karp argues will determine the winner of the US-China geopolitical struggle.

briefings.title: How to Win Maximally | Ted Mabrey at AIPCon 9
briefings.tldr: Palantir is witnessing a dramatic "step change" in deployment velocity where complex enterprise applications are now operationalized in hours or days rather than years, shifting the technology's purpose from incremental efficiency to total market dominance.

briefings.title: 🔴 Dr. Alex Karp LIVE on TBPN
briefings.tldr: Palantir and industry analysts characterize the current AI era as a "Fourth Industrial Revolution" that is rapidly transforming commercial sectors, accelerating software deployment to near-zero latency, and necessitating a radical shift in labor skills to survive significant white-collar job displacement.

briefings.title: Palantir CEO on Iran, AI Weapons and America's Advantage | a16z American Dynamism Summit
briefings.tldr: America has re-established a decisive technological deterrent against adversaries like China and Russia, but this advantage is fragile; Silicon Valley must embrace its obligation to the warfighter and national defense or risk the eventual nationalization of the technology industry.

briefings.title: What Peter Thiel has to do with Germany’s drones | Berlin Briefing Podcast
briefings.tldr: Germany is fast-tracking a multi-billion euro combat drone deal with startups Helsing and Stark Defense to modernize the Bundeswehr, but the involvement of controversial U.S. investor Peter Thiel in Stark Defense has ignited a fierce political debate over national security, data privacy, and democratic values.
